title: Amazing Autumn Spanish Potatoes Hash
description: A funky and springy Spanish dish featuring floury potatoes, ferment kimchi, and ayurvedic sattvic friendly ingredients, perfect for a brunch mood. This dish combines the flavors of Basque cuisine with the health benefits of sattvic food.

ingredients.name: potatoes
ingredients.notes: floury potatoes like Russet or Idaho

ingredients.name: kimchi
ingredients.notes: ferment kimchi with Korean chili flakes

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Peel and dice the potatoes into 1-inch cubes and boil them in salted water until they are slightly tender.
Drain the potatoes and set them aside to cool.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the sliced onion until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the cooked potatoes, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the ferment kimchi to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the potato mixture to a baking dish and bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, until the potatoes are golden brown.
Remove the dish from the oven and sprinkle the chopped parsley on top.
Serve the Amazing Autumn Spanish Potatoes Hash hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
